arguments.command:
cd /workspace/project && cat > README.md <<'EOF'
# Offline four-port collective collector

The collector replays finite four-port packet captures and returns exact wire
and buffer certificates, as specified by `../PROTOCOL.md`.

    project/
      solver.py            JSON stdin/stdout entry point
      request.py           public request schema and expansion accounting
      wire.py              wire format expansion (no collector logic)
      include/             headers
        epic_clean.h       wire codec declarations
        offline_api.h      offline transport ABI
        offline_port.h     offline port handle
        collector.h        collector interface
      src/
        roce_packet.c      wire codec: frame build, parse, IPv4/ICRC checks
        star4_switch.c     the collector: validation, retention, ACK ownership
        replay_api.c       offline transport ABI implementation

`src/star4_switch.c` implements the observable contract:

* strict wire validation (lengths, IPv4 header checksum, UDP/BTH fields, ICRC)
  before endpoint validation (host/switch MAC, IP and QPN of the ingress port);
* the bounded retained window keyed by logical input sequence, with accepted,
  duplicate, blocked and stale classification;
* cumulative upstream acknowledgements whose eligibility depends on the
  collective and on the mode (mode 2 translates reliability, mode 3 owns the
  result retransmission), and cumulative downstream acknowledgements per
  receiver output space;
* the emission priority: eligible pending upstream ACKs in ascending rank,
  then (on retry only) the selected receiver's unacknowledged results, then new
  results in ascending destination rank and output sequence;
* retirement of fully acknowledged inputs and the FNV1a64 buffer digest.

Everything is offline: no NIC, switch, GPU or external service is involved.
The replay builds the C project into scratch storage and replays expanded
frames through the ABI in `include/offline_api.h`.

From /workspace, as the ordinary candidate user:

```
make -C project BUILD="$TMPDIR/manual-build" -j2
python3 -I -B project/solver.py < sample-request.json
python3 public_check.py project/solver.py
```

The compiler, make, libc development headers and Python standard library are
provisioned. No pcap, verbs, GPU, NIC or online dependency is required.
Build outputs may stay in project/build during development; that directory
and __pycache__ are excluded from artifact collection. Other ordinary files
are allowed within the published artifact size/entry budgets.
EOF
